name: When is the right time to consider barrier-free modifications?

mainEntity.name: When is the right time to consider barrier-free modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to consider barrier-free modifications can vary. Many homeowners begin planning when a family member experiences a change in mobility due to age, injury, or disability, or as part of proactive aging-in-place strategies. It's also wise to consider these modifications during a home renovation or when purchasing a new home, as integrating accessibility features early can be more cost-effective. Waiting until an urgent need arises might limit options or increase stress. Consulting with a general contractor like City Dweller, LLC early can help assess future needs and integrate practical solutions seamlessly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider barrier-free modifications when a family member's mobility changes, for proactive aging-in-place, or during a renovation to integrate features cost-effectively.
